# Segmented

Segmented control: switches between two to five mutually exclusive options, with an indicator that slides
between them.

**Interaction**: the indicator slides to the selected option along the spring and the options keep their
width; after focusing it with `Tab`, the arrow keys change the selection.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Switching views (list / grid), time ranges (today / this week / this month)

## Import

```ts
import { Segmented } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Switches between two to five mutually exclusive options.

```tsx
import { Segmented } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Segmented
      defaultValue="list"
      options={[
        { value: 'list', label: 'List' },
        { value: 'grid', label: 'Grid' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Time range

```tsx
import { Segmented } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Range() {
  return (
    <Segmented
      defaultValue="week"
      options={[
        { value: 'today', label: 'Today' },
        { value: 'week', label: 'This week' },
        { value: 'month', label: 'This month' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly (V \| SegmentedOption<V>)[]` | The options: plain values (shown as text) or option objects. | — | Yes |
| `value` | `V` | Value of the selected option (controlled). | — | No |
| `defaultValue` | `V` | Initially selected value (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(value: V) => void` | Called with the value of the newly selected option. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables all options. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size: `sm` in toolbars and panel headers. | — | No |
| `block` | `boolean` | Fills the width of the container; the options share it equally. | — | No |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | The root element. | — | No |

Also accepts the attributes of the native element (`HTMLAttributes`), such as `disabled` and `onClick`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### SegmentedOption<V>

An option of Segmented: a ChoiceOption that can also have an icon.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Text of the option; leave it out for an option with only an icon (then give `title`). | — | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon before the label, by name (like Button and IconButton). | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Tooltip of the option; required for an option with only an icon, where it is also the accessible name. | — | No |
| `value` | `V` | Value of the option. | — | Yes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | The option cannot be chosen. | — | No |

### ChoiceOption<V>

An option of Checkbox.Group, Radio.Group or Segmented.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `V` | Value of the option. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Text of the option. | — | Yes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | The option cannot be chosen. | — | No |

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

118 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
